title: Exact SAT language with polynomially bounded wide-clause width product
claims: ExactProductBudgetSAT checks P membership for the exact canonical language with product of widths of clauses wider than two bounded by a fixed polynomial of input length.
MeasuredMixedRadixUnits computes a unit-clause branch for a unary mixed-radix index and covers every satisfying assignment within the exact product bound.
MeasuredCappedClauseProduct checks the exact capped width product for arbitrary canonical CNF.
MeasuredUnaryDivMod checks exact tagged unary quotient and remainder.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
